description: This file defines the `Functional` module in the `torch::nn` namespace, which wraps an arbitrary function or function object and makes it usable as an `nn::Module`. It includes the class `FunctionalImpl` with methods for construction, resetting, printing, and forwarding tensors, as well as handling argument binding and serialization aspects. It also defines a `ModuleHolder` alias for `FunctionalImpl`.

classes.name: FunctionalImpl
classes.description: A class that wraps a function in a `Module`, allowing it to be used within a model as a parameterized module object. It supports argument binding and serialization.

methods.name: FunctionalImpl(SomeFunction original_function,Args &&...args)
methods.description: Constructor that creates a `FunctionalImpl` from a `std::function` or binds a function with specific arguments.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the internal state of the module.

methods.name: pretty_print
methods.description: Pretty-prints the module details into the provided output stream.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Forwards a `Tensor` input through the wrapped function.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Allows the object to be called as a function, forwarding the input tensor.

methods.name: is_serializable
methods.description: Returns whether the module can be serialized.
